hero.headline: Fremont's home for flawless nails
hero.sub: A licensed team, spotless tools, and finishes that hold up. Serving Fremont seven days a week.

story.title: Welcome to Sparkle Nails
body: Sparkle Nails is a full-service nail studio in Fremont, where a licensed team handles everything from a clean classic manicure to sculpted extensions and custom art.

Every service starts with properly sterilized tools and a fresh file. We take the time to prep the nail correctly, because that is the difference between a set that lasts a weekend and one that lasts for weeks.
We are open seven days a week, and walk-ins are always welcome — though a quick call to (510) 494-8288 guarantees your spot.

trust.label: Open every day of the week

why.title: A real spa experience
why.body: Massage chairs, a calm room, and time that never feels rushed — treatment, not transaction.

why.title: Genuinely warm service
why.body: You get greeted by name, not processed through a queue. Our regulars stay regulars for a reason.

why.title: Custom nail art on request
why.body: Bring a screenshot or an idea. Our techs design freehand and match what you had in mind.

why.title: Honest, fair pricing
why.body: Clear pricing quoted up front. No surprise add-ons appearing on the bill at checkout.

why.title: Experienced technicians
why.body: A licensed team that has been shaping, sculpting, and painting nails for years.

why.title: Spotless and sanitized
why.body: Fresh files, liners, and fully sterilized tools for every single guest — no exceptions.

reviews.author: Andriana Enix
reviews.text: I trust Jenny with my nails more than anyone. She has done my nails for my engagement, my engagement party, my bachelorette, my wedding and even my graduation. The ladies here are great and are very kind and accommodating. The prices are more than fair for the Bay Area.

reviews.author: Deborah Joplin
reviews.text: Cindy provided the best pedicure I have had in years! I will be going back every time. So thankful!

reviews.author: Alexandra Alexa
reviews.text: Jenny does my nails each time, and I like it very much. Thank you, Sparkle Nails!
